title: Smoked Tagine Potato Gratin
description: A rich and creamy French-inspired gratin featuring smoked tagine-spiced potatoes. A perfect side dish for any occasion.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine sliced sweet potatoes and enough cold water to cover.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Drain sweet potatoes and set aside.
In a separate saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add tagine, lively, and jamaican, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add grated gruyère and stir until melted and smooth.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of sweet potato slices.
Pour some of the tagine-gruyère sauce over the sweet potatoes, then repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of sauce on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
